nominations.description: Daniel Desmond Domenico, of Colorado, to be United States Circuit Judge for the Tenth Circuit, vice Timothy M. Tymkovich, retiring.
nominations.actionText: By unanimous consent agreement, debate and vote 11/16/2026.

nominations.description: Gregory Carl Cook, of Alabama, to be United States District Judge for the Northern District of Alabama, vice R. David Proctor, retired.
nominations.actionText: Confirmed by the Senate by Yea-Nay Vote. 49 - 27. Record Vote Number: 260.

nominations.description: Anna St. John, of Louisiana, to be United States Circuit Judge for the Fifth Circuit, vice Kurt D. Engelhardt, retiring.
nominations.actionText: By unanimous consent agreement, vote to be determined no earlier than Monday, November 16, 2026.

nominations.description: Steven Levine, of Maryland, to be a Member of the Securities and Exchange Commission for a term expiring June 5, 2030, vice Hester Maria Peirce, term expired.
nominations.actionText: Received in the Senate and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.

nominations.description: Nathan Anonick, of Virginia, to be a Commissioner of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission for a term expiring June 19, 2031, vice Rostin Behnam, term expired.
nominations.actionText: Received in the Senate and referred to the Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry.

nominations.description: Kristin N. Johnson, of Michigan, to be a Member of the Securities and Exchange Commission for a term expiring June 5, 2029, vice Caroline A. Crenshaw, term expired.
nominations.actionText: Received in the Senate and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.

nominations.description: Matthew Rowland, of the District of Columbia, to be a Commissioner of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission for the remainder of the term expiring April 13, 2028, vice Summer K. Mersinger.
nominations.actionText: Received in the Senate and referred to the Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry.

nominations.description: Richard Wesley Bennett, of Texas, to be United States District Judge for the Southern District of Texas, vice Andrew S. Hanen, retired.
